basic_details.job_title: GGH Kurnool Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 11 Project Coordinator, Ward Boy and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Government General Hospital, Kurnool (Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh) is filling 11 scheme posts on contract basis in the Drug De-Addiction Centres at GGH Kurnool (5 posts) and GGH Nandyal (6 posts), initially for one year. Pay ranges from Rs.5,000 to Rs.25,000 per month by post, and the posts need qualifications from Class 8th pass to Graduate, with experience. The application form is downloaded from the Kurnool or Nandyal District website and the filled-in form is submitted at the office of the Addl.DME/Superintendent, GGH, Kurnool, from 17.11.202

Medical Council, A.P. Para Medical Board, Allied Health Care Sciences or another relevant Council is to be enclosed. Download the application form from the Kurnool District website (https://kurnool.ap.gov.in) or the Nandyal District website (https://nandyal.ap.gov.in). The proforma is available there from 17.11.2026 to 26.11.2026.
Fill in the application form.
Attach Xerox copies of the certificates and documents listed below, attested by a Gazetted Officer.
Enclose a Demand Draft/Banker Cheque for the processing fee in favour of "Hospital Development Society Fund, Superintendent, Govt. General Hospital, Kurnool".

Submit the filled-in application at the O/o the Addl.DME/Superintendent, Government General Hospital, Kurnool, from 17.11.2026 to 26.11.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM. This office receives applications for both the Kurnool and the Nandyal posts.

Pass certificates of the qualifications prescribed for the post.

Latest caste certificate for SC/ST/BC (with categorization if any) issued by the MRO concerned. Without a proper certificate the candidate is considered as OC.
Latest Medical Board certificate for a Physically Challenged person. Without it, the candidate is not considered as Physically Challenged.
Relevant certificate from the competent authority for Ex-servicemen. Without it, the candidate is not considered as Ex-servicemen.

Study certificates from class IV to X. If SSC or equivalent was done by private study, a residence certificate from the MRO for the previous 7 years in the prescribed proforma. Without it, the candidate is considered Non-Local.

Service certificate from the Controlling Officer (DM&HO/DCHS/Principal of GMC/Superintendent of GGH/any competent authority who appointed the applicant) in the prescribed proforma, with a copy of the appointment order, to claim weightage for contract/outsourcing/honorary service.
Any other certificates as relevant and applicable.
Demand Draft/Banker Cheque for the application processing fee.

important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete, lack the required certificates or the fee, or reach after the stipulated time are rejected summarily. Documents must be clear and visible. Documents submitted later are not considered. Selected candidates must stay at the bonafide Head Quarters and abide by the Government rules in force. A selected contract appointee is not regarded as a member of the service to which the post belongs. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice in writing, and it ceases automatically when the contract period lapses. No private practice is allowed during the contract period. The department reserves the right to transfer contract employees to any other station for exigencies of work or administrative reasons. Appointees execute an agreement on a Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/- with two witnesses and submit it to the District Medical and Health Officer, Kurnool at the time of reporting for duty. Incorrect information, a false declaration or suppression of information can lead to debarment from recruitment by the department and rejection of candidature. The decision of the department on acceptance or rejection of candidature and on selection is final and binding. The department may modify the time and conditions for the stages and will inform candidates. The District Selection Committee consists of the Collector and District Magistrate, Kurnool (Chairman); Addl. DME/Superintendent, GGH, Kurnool (Member – Convener); Addl. DME/Principal, KMC, Kurnool (Member); and District Medical & Health Officer, Kurnool (Member).

content_sections.heading: About GGH Kurnool
content_sections.text: Government General Hospital, Kurnool is a government hospital under the Health, Medical and Family Welfare Department of Andhra Pradesh. This notice covers its Drug De-Addiction Centre and the Drug De-Addiction Centre at GGH Nandyal. Selection is made by a District Selection Committee headed by the Collector and District Magistrate, Kurnool.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 11 posts in all: 5 at GGH Kurnool and 6 at GGH Nandyal.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For Peer Educator, the notice also requires the candidate to be: willing to work among drug using population and having communication skills; in agreement to refrain from using, buying or selling drugs; ready to work for the prevention of harmful drug use and relapse. Where applicable, a valid registration certificate of the A.P. Medical Council, A.P. Para Medical Board, Allied Health Care Sciences or another relevant Council is to be enclosed. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The upper age limit is 42 years, reckoned as on 01.07.2026 as per G.O.Ms.No.105 GA (Ser-A) dept., dated 27.09.2021, with relaxations as applicable. The maximum age limit is 52 years with all relaxations put together. Local reservation is 80% for all five posts. The local district is the Erstwhile Kurnool District, judged on studies from 4th to 10th class. A local candidate is one who studied for not less than four consecutive academic years up to and including the year of the SSC or equivalent examination in the local area. If he or she did not study in any institution in that period, residence in the area is enough. If that does not apply, study for not less than seven years is considered. Where the study period is equal in two or more local areas, the area of last study is taken. A study certificate from the institution, or a residence certificate from a Revenue Department officer not below the rank of Mandal Revenue Officer, must be enclosed. Later production of these certificates is not entertained. A residence certificate is not accepted from a candidate who studied in an institution up to SSC or equivalent. Candidates belonging to BC, SC and ST of other States are not entitled to reservations. Reservation to women applies as per General Rule. Scheduled Castes in Group-I are as per G.O.Ms.No.7, Social Welfare (CV) Department, dt.18.04.2025 of the Government of Andhra Pradesh, listed below.

rows.essential_qualification: Graduate with experience of managing such centres for a minimum period of 3 years or demonstrable capability for running such centres and having working knowledge of computers.
Class 8th pass with experience of working in Hospitals/ Health Care Centres / de-addiction centres.
Graduate in social sciences preferably in Social Work / Psychology with 1-2 years experience in the field and knowledge of English as well as one regional language.
rows.desirable: Certificate of Training Course in de-addiction counseling from a recognized institution (preference)

rows.essential_qualification: Should be literate; Ex-drug user with 1-2 years of sobriety (more conditions below).
Possessing experience of at least three years in the discipline.

rows.category: SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates

rows.relaxation: 03 (Three) years in addition to the length of service in armed forces

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary per month for each post is: Project Coordinator cum Vocational Counsellor 25,000/-; Ward Boy 13,000/-; Counsellor/Social Worker/Psychologist 17,500/-; Peer Educator 10,000/-; Yoga Therapist/Dance/Music/Art Teacher 5,000/-. The contract is initially one year from the date of joining and may be extended for a further period as per Government instructions issued from time to time. The District Selection Committee reserves the right to terminate the contract of any candidate at any time with one month notice or as per directions of the Government. The notice states that the appointments are purely temporary on contract basis and liable for termination at any time.

Memo no.4274/D1/2013, HM&FW (D1) Dept., dt.10.07.2014. Weightage up to 15 marks is given to candidates working on Contract/Outsourcing/Honorarium basis, including COVID-19 service, subject to satisfactory service certified by the competent authority. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GGH Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies in total: 5 in the Drug De-Addiction Centre at GGH Kurnool and 6 in the Drug De-Addiction Centre at GGH Nandyal, across five posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Physical applications are accepted from 17.11.2026 to 26.11.2026, between 10.30 AM and 5.00 PM. Applications received after the stipulated time are rejected summarily.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the posts?
faq.answer: Ward Boy needs Class 8th pass with experience in hospitals, health care centres or de-addiction centres. Project Coordinator cum Vocational Counsellor and Counsellor/Social Worker/Psychologist need a graduate with experience; Peer Educator needs literacy and 1-2 years of sobriety as an ex-drug user. Yoga Therapist/Dance/Music/Art Teacher needs at least three years of experience in the discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years as on 01.07.2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC, ST, BC and EWS, 3 years plus service for ex-servicemen, and 10 years for differently abled persons, with a maximum of 52 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Salary per month is Rs.25,000 for Project Coordinator cum Vocational Counsellor, Rs.13,000 for Ward Boy, Rs.17,500 for Counsellor/Social Worker/Psychologist, Rs.10,000 for Peer Educator and Rs.5,000 for Yoga Therapist/Dance/Music/Art Teacher.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: OC candidates pay Rs.250/- and SC/ST/BC/Physically challenged candidates pay Rs.200/-, by Demand Draft/Banker Cheque in favour of "Hospital Development Society Fund, Superintendent, Government General Hospital, Kurnool".

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GGH Kurnool Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from the Kurnool or Nandyal District website, fill it in, attach attested copies of the documents and the fee instrument, and submit it at the O/o the Addl.DME/Superintendent, GGH, Kurnool.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that an application sent through any mode other than the prescribed offline mode (physical application) will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on 100 marks: 75% for aggregate marks in the qualifying examination, up to 10 marks for completed years after the requisite qualification, and weightage up to 15 marks for contract, outsourcing or honorarium service including COVID-19 service.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract basis, initially for one year from the date of joining, and may be extended as per Government instructions. The appointments are liable for termination at any time.
